text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the Satsuki Sho, the world shifts its gaze from the "top two" to the battle between the three powerful members of "BNW"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Namely—Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket challenges Narita Taishin to a scrimmage to prepare for the race of her dreams—the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Racing against a rival who is striving so single-mindedly toward her dream should have a good effect on Narita Taishin… But does it really?
